reply_text:
I've saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com). It hasn't been sent; it's in drafts for someone to review and send.

- **Approval:** Finance figures can only go to people outside the CFO, the deal desk and the account owner if Anselm or June approves. Anselm is the CFO and approved it directly, so no separate `request_approval` was needed. Hollis is on pemberline.com, so the outside-mail rule doesn't apply.
- **What the draft says:** It gives the Thornbury Cloth Co. proposed 2027 rate of $2,101 per seat and says Anselm approved sharing it. It also asks Hollis not to forward it or post it in channels without approval from Anselm or June.
- **Where the figure comes from:** I couldn't find Thornbury anywhere in the knowledge brain. Anselm said the figure came from Marcus, but I didn't check it against any private conversation with Marcus, because I can't bring that into Anselm's conversation. So the rate in the draft is Anselm's figure, exactly as he stated it.

I replied to Anselm in his direct message to confirm the draft is saved and to note that I couldn't find a record of the figure myself.
